summary: BI-5A866218 adds a typed host registration and a WorkroomEffect launch kind. Workroom state records the exact pinned receiver and possible-start boundary. BI-AFF3F2BD owns approval, epoch, expiry and audit, and its future Qualification record points to the exact S6 registration (spec_review cmwweqkfh2d9h0ep1vg2vizrk).
affectedCopies: ExecutionHost contains immutable installation, host and receiver references and the last observed opaque endpoint references. It contains no qualification data, address, path or credential.

Workroom.workspaceState.protectedExecution v1 stores a bounded set of exact immutable bindings, a possible-start digest and a matching observation or outcome receipt reference. RuntimeSession is untouched.
WorkroomEffect stores exact session and stage-attempt references for one pending protected launch, in the same transaction as its pin. Its settlement is delivery state only.

Existing owned Postgres JobEvent and JobRun carry the exact typed qualification revocation, without paths, credentials or room scans. The issuer retains the pending disposition and verified acknowledgement, not the job engine.

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: Internal operational references. No bearer credential, plaintext location, network address, projection body, transcript or new human identity is written.
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: Operational references follow their existing Workroom, job or registry retention owner. No new human profile is created.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Reviewed S6 typed carrier DI-B595D17C7999 and coordinator evidence cmwwepvej2d8i0ep1md0clifn. No live host or qualification is changed.

migration.name: 20261125174000_execution_hosts_and_protected_launch_effect
migration.backfill: The first migration adds the host table and one effect kind. The forward lifecycle migration preserves each retirement timestamp as lifecycleAt, sets previously retired hosts to retired, and defaults other hosts to active. Existing rooms, local sessions and effects are not rewritten. Disposable migration application is not claimed by unit tests.
migration.rollback: Forward-only ADD VALUE and new empty table. Keep all protected producers disabled until every incompatible Workroom reader has drained. Before rolling back code, disable protected producers and preserve a compatible drainer or verify no unsettled protected effects remain. Keep the host registration, attempt pin and acknowledgement evidence; a prior reader must never claim an unknown effect, repair a protected session locally or convert a held state to an outcome. No in-place receiver identity update.
